name: Emmanuel de Graffenried
features: fair skin, dark hair receding at the temples, dark eyes, aquiline face, neat moustache, slim upright build, courteous amused expression
bio: Baron Emmanuel 'Toulo' de Graffenried, a Swiss aristocrat who won the 1949 British Grand Prix at Silverstone in Enrico Plate's Maserati 4CLT/48 - the last major victory before the World Championship began. Raced on into the 1950s, and later ran Alfa Romeo and Mercedes agencies in Switzerland, a country that had banned the sport he made his name in.
